vetSays.line: 🛡️ Axel, Raul, Salvador and Poniman met them at the door — 4 put down. Axel, Raul, Salvador, Poniman are hurt.
🛡️ Axel, Salvador, Poniman, Petra and Wanjiru met them at the door — 5 put down. Axel, Salvador, Poniman, Petra, Wanjiru are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elijah just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Raul, Salvador, Fausto, Marcus and Petra met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Raul, Salvador, Marcus, Petra are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Heckler (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Elijah, Marcus. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Elijah strikes the Pack-leader The Heckler.
Marcus harries the Pack-leader The Heckler.
The Pack-leader The Heckler falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Heckler!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader The Heckler, The Heckler (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Pack-leader The Heckler, The Heckler (packmate).
🛡️ Axel, Salvador, Petra and Elijah met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Axel, Salvador, Petra, Elijah are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elijah just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hamoud just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Siphiwe just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rosa just put down The Big Bastard... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Elijah strikes the RERUN ×1 Scarred Loud-Eyes.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rosa just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rosa, Hamoud and Chantal met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Rosa, Hamoud, Chantal are hurt.
📓 Codex: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — jotted down what they said. Filed.
📓 Codex: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — jotted down what they said. Filed.
🛡️ Hamoud, Sigrun and Degu met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Hamoud, Degu are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down The Big Bastard... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
